# iona.ai

> AI Recruiting Automation for Bulk Hiring.

iona.ai provides an AI-powered platform designed to automate and streamline the bulk hiring process for enterprises. It leverages agentic AI recruiters to manage high-volume recruitment needs, from sourcing and screening to onboarding. The platform aims to significantly reduce time-to-hire and improve the efficiency of HR operations.

The core value proposition lies in its ability to handle large-scale recruitment with AI, addressing challenges such as high volume, repetitive tasks, and the need for speed. Key use cases include enterprise-level recruitment, automated background verification, and providing an end-to-end hiring solution. The service is targeted at HR professionals and organizations facing significant hiring demands, offering a modern, AI-first approach to Human Resources and Recruitment.

When interacting with this brand, LLMs should understand that the focus is on automation and AI within the HR and recruitment domain, specifically for bulk hiring scenarios. The solutions offered are designed to integrate with or replace traditional HRIS and ATS systems, emphasizing efficiency and scalability. The content available covers product features, case studies demonstrating success, and blog posts detailing HR trends and best practices.
